name: ROACH (FPS STORY)
desc:
🔥 Progress through linear story missions and fight the roaches in co-op!
🛠️ This game is a work in progress. It is not meant to be taken seriously. Play with low expectations and have fun.

[Controls]
🎵 M – Mute Music
💃 G – Emote

[Premium Benefits]
🎁 Exclusive daily reward chest.

👥 VIP servers support up to 50 players.

🎮 Inspired by classic Roblox co-op story shooters and many other first-person shooters.

💸 All purchases are optional and support the developers. Stories can be completed for free.

⭐ Like, favorite, and join the group for updates.

Tags: fps, action, story, coop, roach, roaches, horror, friends, multiplayer, solve, work together
